threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: Calling it the 'Tube' instead of the 'Underground' is a dead giveaway. Locals just call it the 'Overground' when it's not a hassle.
Caught the N68 home last night, and a group of teens turned an empty seat into a makeshift stage for an impromptu rap battle. Quite the show!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids playing football in the street while their parents gathered for a grill on the sidewalk. Classic Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a laundromat that doubles as a bar. You can sip a Berliner Pilsner while waiting for your laundry to spin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they don’t even flinch hearing the BART’s brakes screeching like a cat on a hot tin roof. It’s just background noise.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling on the 19 bus today while a toddler giggled. That’s San Francisco – chaos and charm all in one ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just for tapas and bars, but it’s really the locals who cherish the hidden plaça where kids play and artists gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their reluctance to squeeze onto the metro during rush hour, standing awkwardly by the doors instead.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: Saying you take the tube instead of the overground for a quick trip to Shoreditch is a dead giveaway. Locals know the tracks and times like the back of their hand.
Caught a night bus from Brixton, overheard a guy arguing with a mannequin he thought was his mate. Only in London, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was really in Neukölln when I saw an old man in a bathrobe arguing with a pigeon over the last piece of bread on the sidewalk.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a kebab shop doubling as an art gallery, where the döner is served alongside rotating local artwork. Uniquely Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from the Mission when they bring their own reusable straw to the taco truck; the metal ones have a certain flair around here.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus that stopped for 10 minutes while the driver scolded a passenger for not having exact change. Classic Tenderloin chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just for Gaudí sights. They miss the hidden plazas where locals share a quiet vermut on a weekday afternoon.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they struggle with the metro ticket machines, staring confusedly at the screen like it's an alien artifact.
